name: prorated-refund-calculator
title_zh: 按天折算退款与换购差价，精确到分
tagline_zh: 客户中途取消会员、坏机换新机，别再拍脑袋估数。脚本算清剩余天数与差价，账目经得起对账。
tagline_en: Stop guessing refunds when members cancel mid-cycle or defective units get traded up. Exact prorated math.
desc_en: Calculate the exact prorated refund when a customer cancels a BlastPass membership, and the net settlement when a defective unit is traded up to a pricier model. Use after the Store Policy Agent confirms the refund rule and the Membership MCP has returned the membership details. The skill runs a bundled Python script so the arithmetic is exact.
why_zh: 不是调库，是内置 Python 脚本逐日计算，避开浮点误差；且只在你确认政策、拿到会员数据后才动手。
why_en: Bundled Python does day-level arithmetic, dodging float drift. It fires only after policy confirmation and membership data.
limit_zh: 只认 BlastPass 会员取消与单件换购两种场景；需要先有 Store Policy Agent 的规则确认和 M。
limit_en: Only BlastPass cancellations and single-unit trade-ups. Requires prior policy confirmation and membership data; stops otherwise. No payout, tax, or.
